scope: Small account subset exported from a private local mainnet replay capture; provenance hashes only, not independently verified on-chain

source.ordering: position -2=before initialization; -1=automatic initialization;0..n-1=post transaction;n=final phase; order is a per-slot callback number from one run, only meaningful between same-account writes at the same position
source.proof_limit: Private source captures are not distributed; hashes alone do not allow independent on-chain provenance verification or provide a consensus account proof
